name: Marriage And Children
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is God's ordained design for companionship and unity, as the man leaves his parents to cleave to his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:18, 24). God blesses marriage with the command to be fruitful and multiply, establishing families as part of His divine plan for dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:28). The Lord's favor is evident in the blessing of finding a wife, and love within marriage is vital to covering sins and resolving strife (Proverbs 18:22; 10:12). Moreover, the foundation and protection of the family depend on the Lord’s involvement, for without Him, human efforts are in vain (Psalms 127:1).
